resources.name: Crystal structures of BaReH9 and BaMnH9

access.notes: Space group P6₃/mmc, lattice parameters: BaReH9 a=5.287 Å, c=9.323 Å; BaMnH9 a=5.067 Å, c=8.883 Å. Wyckoff positions: Ba 2a (0,0,0), Re/Mn 2c (1/3,2/3,1/4), H1 6h (x,2x,1/4), H2 12k (x,2x,z). H positions to be relaxed.
